summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a 6-K containing a press release announcing that the Colombian National Mining Agency granted additional mining titles after public hearings. The filing describes regulatory milestones and expanded land positions at the Guayabales Project. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or change of control is involved. The filing is a routine operational update about mineral title expansion, not a special-situation event. The registrant is the issuer reporting a business development with no financial terms or strategic review. What to watch: exploration progress and drilling updates.
